sloka: भित्त्वा शरै रथं रामो रथाश्वान् समपातयत्।विरथो वसुधां तिष्ठन् मकराक्षो निशाचरः ।। ६.७९.३० ।।
transliteration: bhittvā śarai rathaṁ rāmo rathāśvān samapātayat।viratho vasudhāṁ tiṣṭhan makarākṣo niśācaraḥ ।। 6.79.30 ।।

translations.english: Rama broke the chariot, killed the horses, and laid down the night ranger Maka raksha. Deprived of the chariot he stood on the ground.
